v_effect = {
	add_gold = $AMOUNT$
}
v_list_effect = {
	every_adult_child = { add_gold = 1 }
	add_to_variable_list = { name = seen_list target = root }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = seen_list
		add_gold = 1
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { v_trigger = { TARGET = root } }
			v_effect = { AMOUNT = 1 }
		}
	}
}
v_gift_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { any_child = { is_adult = yes } } }
		add_gold = small_value
	}
	else = {
		v_effect = { AMOUNT = 2 }
		v_list_effect = yes
	}
}
